metadata.title: ScholaForge
metadata.description:
A school operating system that puts transparency and fairness at the centre of every decision made about students, teachers and resources. ScholaForge handles curriculum, assessment, resource management and student progression, and makes every decision explainable, auditable and traceable.

Designed for Belgian and European Union schools, covering all three language communities (Dutch, French and German).

Pre-release research software. Not deployed in production. Not independently reproduced or peer reviewed.
